dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a very low density of high-luminance features, with only 3-4 small, faint clusters visible near the posterior insertion point.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, fusiform objects attached to the ventral and posterior regions of the pectoral fin, consistent with commensal organisms.
